items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Martha Glaser asked to ask you: You knew you were being recorded...

ctx.x: On Dial. Martha Glaser asked to ask you: You knew you were being recorded at Gene Norman's Just Jazz concerts, and you said you didn't think about those things, you were just playing and you didn't notice. Right?

Yeah. I really didn't notice. I knew they had...what was it, a wire recorder or tape recorder set up, but I didn't think about it being for commercial reasons. But later, it did turn out to be commercial.
